application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T7 Magnolia (x1) - Reduce back to previous points of reduction. 1-1.5m all round and thin by 20%. Final height to be 5m and width to be 6m. Reason: General maintenance. To maintain the tree at a smaller size. 
T8 Ash (x1) - Reduce back to previous points of reduction. 1.5-2m all round. Final height to be 7m and width to be 5m. Reason: General maintenance. To maintain the tree at a smaller size. 
T9 Ash (x2) - Reduce branches overhanging Northwick House back to boundary (by approximately 2m). Final height to be 8m and width to be 5m. Reason: General maintenance. To maintain the tree at a smaller size. 
T10 Amelanchier (x1) - Reduce crown by 1m all round. Final height to be 4m and width to be 3m. Reason: General maintenance. To maintain the tree at a smaller size. 
T12 Cherry (x1) - Reduce crown by 1m all round and remove deadwood. Final height to be 4m and width to be 4m. Reason: General maintenance. To maintain the tree at a smaller size.
